full_prompt_en: A square loose political caricature sketch shows two stern suited men crowded together in three quarter profile against nearly blank white paper. The larger figure at left has swept pale hair, a deeply furrowed brow, long nose, heavy lower lip, and a sharply turned face. His gray green jacket and dark tie are rendered in a few broad angular washes, with scratchy black lines adding lapels and shoulder folds. Immediately behind him at right, a second man with thin glasses and a long pointed nose leans into the same direction. His face is more lightly sketched, its gray contours visible between the first man's cheek and the open paper. Both stare toward the right edge, their large heads taking almost the entire upper half of the frame. The lower half tapers into unfinished jacket strokes and open white space. Rapid looping lines above the pale hair imply motion and drawing energy without forming a separate object. Warm ocher touches on the cheeks, nose, and neck provide a narrow accent against cool gray, teal, and black. Fine pencil marks and darker pen strokes cross one another in the facial wrinkles, while wide transparent brushmarks block the clothing. Light is diffuse and even, with little modeled shadow outside the hatched planes. A small signaturelike scribble lies near the lower right. The image feels urgent and opinionated, its exaggeration carried by quick contour, overlapping expressions, and the deliberately unfinished page.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形松动政治讽刺速写在几乎空白的白纸上把两位严肃西装男子挤在一起，以四分之三侧面出现。左侧较大人物有向后扫的浅发、深皱的眉、长鼻、厚下唇和猛然转开的脸。灰绿外套与深领带由几道宽阔棱角洗色画出，带刮擦感的黑线添加翻领和肩部褶纹。紧贴他右后，第二位戴细眼镜、长尖鼻的男子朝同一方向探来。他的脸画得更浅，灰色轮廓在第一人的面颊与开放纸面间可见。两人都望向右边缘，大头几乎占满画面上半部。下半部渐成未完成的外套笔痕与开放白纸。浅发上方快速盘绕线暗示运动和作画能量，却不构成另一个物件。面颊、鼻子和颈部的暖赭色小块在冷灰、深青与黑色中提供狭窄重音。细铅笔痕和更深钢笔线在面部皱纹里交错，宽阔透明笔痕概括衣服。光漫射均匀，排线平面之外少有塑造阴影。右下附近有一处像签名的小涂写。图像急切而有态度，夸张由迅捷轮廓、重叠神情与刻意未完成的纸页承载。
style_prompt_en: Loose editorial caricature sketch combines fast looping contours, angular wash blocks, and visible construction lines. Enlarged overlapping upper forms taper into sparse unfinished marks below, leaving broad white paper around the composition. Dark graphite and ink strokes define the sharpest focal edges; transparent gray green and small ocher touches supply light color. Fine crossing lines gather where expression or texture is most intense, while broad strokes summarize the quieter masses. Proportions are dramatically stretched yet anchored by a coherent direction of attention. Diffuse daylight keeps the page bright and the shadows shallow, with value supplied largely by hatching and line density. The result feels immediate, witty, and restless, preserving the energy of an observed drawing in progress.
style_prompt_zh: 松动编辑讽刺速写结合快速盘绕轮廓、棱角洗色块和可见结构线。放大重叠的上部形体向下渐成稀疏未完成笔痕，构图周围保留宽阔白纸。深石墨与墨线确定最尖锐焦点边缘；透明灰绿和少量赭色提供轻颜色。细交叉线聚在表情或肌理最强之处，宽笔触概括较安静体块。比例受到戏剧性拉伸，但仍由统一的注意力方向固定。漫射日光保持纸面明亮、阴影浅薄，明度主要由排线与线密度提供。效果即时、机智而躁动，保留正在形成中的观察式绘画能量。
theme_en: Two stern suited men in a loose political caricature sketch
theme_zh: 两位表情严厉的西装男子出现在松动政治讽刺速写中
name: Pat Bagley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
